# LLM Gateway Bench

> An open, user-perspective, **black-box** benchmark for LLM API gateways / relays. It doesn't trust claims — it measures behavior: latency (TTFT/throughput), success rate, price multiple, and trust/fidelity fingerprints (model-echo to catch silent model substitution, fake-streaming, inflated token usage, CJK/quantization tells, context truncation, prompt-cache). Serverless and reproducible: raw probe data is committed to the repo and anyone can reproduce results with their own key.

Methodology is the product: probe scripts, prompts, thresholds, raw data and aggregation are all open. Metric definitions align with llmperf / Artificial Analysis / OpenRouter (e.g. decode throughput = tokens after the first ÷ decode time; uptime excludes user-side 4xx). The leaderboard shows per-dimension columns — no black-box composite score.

## Core
- [Live dashboard](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/): "pick-for-me" selector, gateway leaderboard, behavior fingerprints, price comparison, and a gap-check ("my gateway vs the best").
- [Model evaluations](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/evals.html): which model is the best value (price-value + authoritative benchmarks).
- [Price comparison](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/pricing.html): classic-model × gateway public pricing.
- [Report gallery](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/reports.html): shareable per-run reports (model × gateway, long-context, price).
- [Source & methodology (README + docs)](https://github.com/cuihuan/llm-gateway-bench): how each metric is measured, the detection toolbox, and how to run it yourself.

## Knowledge base (articles)
- [Does your gateway break Claude Code? Measuring tool-call fidelity + overhead](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/article.html?slug=does-your-gateway-break-claude-code) — a keyless, reproducible experiment across the popular gateways: passthrough LiteLLM 3/3 · Bifrost 3/3 · Portkey OSS 1/3 (drops streaming); cross-format (Claude Code → OpenAI) LiteLLM 3/3 · Bifrost 3/3 · Portkey OSS not-offered; LiteLLM's /v1/messages transport changed across versions (Chat Completions → Responses API) so pin your version. Fast ≠ faithful — one overhead×fidelity chart.
- [Choosing a gateway — a complete framework](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/article.html?slug=choosing-a-gateway)
- [Model substitution & silent downgrade: how to detect it black-box](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/article.html?slug=model-substitution)
- [Billing traps: inflated tokens, fake streaming, context truncation](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/article.html?slug=billing-traps)
- [Stability & exit-scam risk: time series is the moat](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/article.html?slug=stability-and-exit-risk)
- [How the price index is computed and read](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/article.html?slug=price-index)
- [How we probe and why it's trustworthy](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/article.html?slug=methodology-trust)
- [Self-hosting the probe in your own environment](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/article.html?slug=self-host-probing)
- [OpenAI-compatible ≠ behavior-identical: protocol-layer pitfalls](https://cuihuan.github.io/llm-gateway-bench/article.html?slug=openai-compat-pitfalls) — incl. cross-format translation (Claude Code / Anthropic client → OpenAI upstream): why tool calls break, and how LiteLLM's /v1/messages transport changed across versions (Chat Completions → Responses API).

## Companion tools (same author)
- [awesome-ai-gateway](https://github.com/cuihuan/awesome-ai-gateway): curated list of 100+ AI gateways + reproducible cost benchmark + scorecard — to *pick* a gateway.
- [modelprobe](https://github.com/cuihuan/modelprobe): tiny dependency-free Go availability prober — per model, is it up and how fast.
